title: An account joined an organization (OP-151 m.3 (i))
description: The member of the SET `events` claim, and of the CloudEvent `data.events`, under `urn:suiss:access:event:membership.added`. A notification, never an authority source: losing or delaying it changes no decision (INV-24).

account.description: The account's opaque external id (OP-137): pseudonymous, never an identifier or a name.
